items.scene: A young cook presses the big red RESET button (ruh-SEHT) on the stove's control panel with one finger, a blank RECIPE card in her other hand, to start all over again.
Steam from a big copper pot of SOUP (SOOP) curls up into a giant LOOP-the-loop.
A cook at the stove, eyes closed and smiling, SAVOURS (sah-VUHR) the FLAVOUR on her wooden spoon.
A pony MARE sits on the floor hugging her TUM (ah-mehr-TEWM), face all puckered, half a bitten lemon at her hooves: such BITTERNESS!
A little girl on a stool licks a spoonful of sticky purple GOO from her bowl and smacks her lips: what a TASTE!
A grown-up deli man in a flat cap waves 'SEE YA!' to the DELI (day-lee-SYEUH) with one hand and holds up a DELICIOUS strawberry cream tart in the other.
A GREEN parrot on the grill rail cheers 'YAY!' (gree-YAY), wings wide, over sausages GRILLED with black stripes.
A COOK so QUEASY he has turned green all over sits stirring his pot, his bandaged KNEE (kwee-zee-NYAY) resting on a footstool.
A shaggy HAIRY COW (ah-ree-KOH) leans in at the window and munches a long green BEAN from a colander on the sill.
